chunks: "Catch it," said He, "and have no fear; We shall revert it to its former state."
ai.seo_question: What happened when Prophet Musa caught the serpent in Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this command to 'take it and fear not' highlights the transition of Musa from witnessing the miracle to actively possessing it, symbolizing the consolidation of divine authority. The phrase 'We will restore its first way' underscores God's absolute power over creation's states, serving as a tangible proof (Ayah) for Pharaoh's court while prefiguring the eventual triumph of truth over tyranny.
